title: Event descriptions
description:
Event name	Definitions
Mkt-pdp-similar-tiles-clicks	When a user clicks on any product inside the Similar Tiles section on a PDP
mkt-roomtiles-toggle-clicks	Fires when a user taps or interacts with any toggle button (Wall / Floor) inside the Room Tiles page
mkt-bathroomtiles-toggle-clicks	Fires when a user taps or interacts with any toggle button (Wall / Floor) inside the Bathroom Tiles page
mkt-kitchentiles-toggle-clicks	Fires when a user taps or interacts with any toggle button (Wall / Floor / Countertop) inside the Kitchen Tiles page
mkt-plp-try-in-my-room-clicks	Fires when a user clicks on theTry in My Room CTA inside any product card for the universal PLPs categories. All the plp pages contains /tiles/ in them. For example page path of the plp page is '/tiles/floor-tiles'. Here all the products that are categorised into Floor Tiles will show up - so we can also say that the category = floor tiles products show up under this plp pages. 
mkt-pdp-tryinmyroom-clicks	Fires when a user clicks on the Try in My Room CTA on the Product Detail Page. All pdp pages doesn't contains '/tiles/' in them. For example below are some pdp pages - 'https://www.orientbell.com/pav-cool-tile-white-023505363150565051h', 'https://www.orientbell.com/canto-ocean-marble-double-charge-vitrified-floor-tiles' etc. 
mkt-plp-find-similar-clicks	Fires when a user clicks on the Find Similar CTA inside any product card for the universal PLPs categories. All the plp pages contains /tiles/ in them. 
mkt-stores-whatsapp-clicks	Fires when a user clicks on any WhatsApp icon/button in the Stores listing page (before or after performing a store search)
mkt-pdp-you-may-also-like-product-clicks	Fires when a user clicks on any product inside the You May Also Like section on a PDP
mkt-roomtiles-viewmore-clicks	Fires when a user clicks on any “View More” button under different size options inside the Room Tiles page
mkt-kitchentiles-viewmore-clicks	Fires when a user clicks on any “View More” button under different size options inside the Kitchen Tiles page
mkt-bathroomtiles-viewmore-clicks	Fires when a user clicks on any “View More” button under different size options inside the Bathroom Tiles page
Mkt_OBLLogoHome_Clicks	Fires when a user clicks on "OBL logo" in Header
Mkt_BreadcrumbHome_Clicks	Fires when a user clicks on "Home" in breadcrumbs across the website
Mkt_SearchBarFindSimilar_Clicks	Fires when a user clicks on "Camera" / Visual search in search bar
Mkt_BottomBar_Contact_Clicks	Fires on clicks for "Contact" bottom bar tab for Mobile
Mkt_BottomBar_ExploreSubCategories_Click	Fires on click of the sub-category (Round circles) inside the Explore tab’s categories in bottom sheet across the website.
Mkt_BottomBar_Whatsapp_Clicks	Fires on click of the “Whatsapp” CTA/button.
Mkt_BottomBar_HomeTab_Clicks	Fires on click of the “Home” Tab across the website.
Mkt_BottomBar_ExploreTab_Clicks	Fires on click of the “Explore” Tab across the website.
Mkt_BottomBar_Call_Clicks	Fires on click of the “Call” CTA/button.
Mkt_NPDExploreNow_Clicks	Fires on "Explore Now" CTA clicks in Newly launched tiles section on Homepage
mkt-homepage-shopbycolor-clicks	Click on CTA “Shop by Color”
mkt-homepage-discoversimilar-clicks	Click on CTA “Discover Similar Tiles”
mkt-homepage-banner-position2-clicks	Click on banner 2 for website in desktop view
mkt-homepage-widgetcategory-clicks	Click on any tile category inside widget
mkt-homepage-exploreourrange-clicks	Click on any subcategory like Antiskid, Elevation etc.
mkt-homepage-headercategory-clicks	Click on any category in top header ribbon
mkt-homepage-tiletrends&tips-clicks	Click on any blog/tile trend article inside Tile Trends & Tips section
Mkt_CatalogSearchFilters_Clicks	Click on "Refine" / "UNBXD Filters" on search pages
mkt-homepage-masterbondexplorerange-clic	Click on "Explore Range" CTA
mkt-form-event	Whenever a form is submitted on the site this event is triggered. This included the book_a_consultation form, enquiry form (popup_form_submit) and ask a tile expert form (ask-tile-expert). When put a filter using the custom dimension popup_id - it gives different fitler for different forms. For example event_name = mkt-form-event and popup id = book-a-consultation will give you the amount of book a consultation forms submit, similarly popup id = ask-tile-expert will give all the forms submited to request a call from tiles expert, and similarly when the popup id = areeq-figurine, this given the number of events when a user launches enquiry form from product display pages
file_download	Whenever a user clicks on downloading a catalogue from the any page - this event is triggered.

title: Event Name: mkt-form-event
description:
Event Name: mkt-form-event
Purpose: This event now tracks the full lifecycle of your forms: views, closes, and submissions.
Associated Custom Dimensions:
customEvent:popup_id: Identifies the specific form (e.g., 'ask-tile-expert', 'book-a-consultation', 'tareeq-figurine').
customEvent:action: Identifies the action a user took with the form, with the following possible values:
viewed
closed
submitted
